messages.content: It defines a server group named `app` with two backends. `proxy_pass http://app` sends requests to that group, and nginx distributes them round-robin by default. If a backend fails, nginx stops sending it requests for a while based on `max_fails` and `fail_timeout`, which default to 1 and 10s.
